"""Temporary CPU endpoint candidate; production retained-prefix scoring is unchanged."""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Sequence
from typing import cast

import torch
from transformers.cache_utils import DynamicCache
from transformers.masking_utils import create_causal_mask
from transformers.models.qwen3.modeling_qwen3 import Qwen3DecoderLayer

from wyat.backends.kai.cpu.prefix import PrefixScorer
from wyat.backends.kai.torch import KaiScorer
from wyat.core import Request

from .block import selected_last_block


def selected_hidden(
    base: KaiScorer,
    ids: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    cache: DynamicCache,
    prefix_length: int,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Run stock early blocks; capture positions/mask before any cache append."""
    backbone = base.backbone
    if cache.get_seq_length() != prefix_length:
        raise ValueError("Selected scoring requires a fresh complete prefix owner")
    hidden = cast(torch.Tensor, backbone.embed_tokens(ids))
    position_ids = (torch.arange(ids.shape[1]) + prefix_length)[None]
    mask = create_causal_mask(
        config=backbone.config,
        inputs_embeds=hidden,
        attention_mask=None,
        past_key_values=cache,
        position_ids=position_ids,
    )
    embeddings = cast(
        tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor], backbone.rotary_emb(hidden, position_ids)
    )
    for layer in backbone.layers[:-1]:
        hidden = cast(
            torch.Tensor,
            layer(
                hidden,
                attention_mask=mask,
                position_ids=position_ids,
                past_key_values=cache,
                use_cache=True,
                position_embeddings=embeddings,
            ),
        )
    return selected_last_block(
        cast(Qwen3DecoderLayer, backbone.layers[-1]),
        backbone.norm,
        hidden,
        positions,
        embeddings,
        cache,
        prefix_length=prefix_length,
    )


class SelectedScorer(PrefixScorer):
    """Independent eager snapshots and per-call disposable caches; no routing change.

    This experimental copy owns only admitted tensor packing/forward/readout.
    Whole-batch fallback uses the original production tensor owner. It earns a
    production boundary only after separately reviewed full77 confirmation.
    """

    def score_many(self, requests: Sequence[Request]) -> list[list[float]]:
        self._require_no_autocast()
        self._require_no_hooks(self.base)
        if not requests:
            return []
        encoded = [self.base.encode_request(request) for request in requests]
        if not all(self._admits(row) for row in encoded):
            return self.base._score_encoded(encoded)
        prefix_length = len(self.prefix)
        batch = len(encoded)
        length = max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded) - prefix_length
        width = max(len(row.candidate_positions) for row in encoded)
        ids = torch.full((batch, length), self.base.pad_id, dtype=torch.long)
        positions = torch.zeros((batch, width + 1), dtype=torch.long)
        for index, row in enumerate(encoded):
            suffix = row.ids[prefix_length:]
            ids[index, : len(suffix)] = torch.tensor(suffix, dtype=torch.long)
            positions[index, : len(row.candidate_positions)] = torch.tensor(
                [value - prefix_length for value in row.candidate_positions]
            )
            positions[index, -1] = row.query_position - prefix_length
        with torch.inference_mode():
            hidden = selected_hidden(
                self.base, ids, positions, self._fork(batch), prefix_length
            )
            logits = cast(torch.Tensor, self.base.head(hidden[:, :-1], hidden[:, -1]))
        values = cast(list[list[float]], logits.float().cpu().tolist())
        return [
            row[: len(item.candidate_positions)]
            for row, item in zip(values, encoded, strict=True)
        ]

"""Run one exploratory CPU endpoint screen in an owned 180-second process."""

from __future__ import annotations

from argparse import ArgumentParser, Namespace
from pathlib import Path

from benchmarks.analysis.torch.process import launch


class Arguments(Namespace):
    model: Path
    output: Path
    worker: bool


def main() -> None:
    parser = ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("model", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--worker", action="store_true", help="internal owned worker")
    args = parser.parse_args(namespace=Arguments())
    if args.worker:
        from .study import study

        raise SystemExit(0 if study(args.model.resolve(), args.output.resolve()) else 1)
    raise SystemExit(
        launch(
            __package__ + ".run",
            args.model.resolve(),
            args.output.resolve(),
            timeout=180,
        )
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def admit_history() -> tuple[int, ...]:
    """Pinned executed archives identify prior runs independently of live source."""
    prefix = original.admit_history()
    original.verify_files({original.RESULTS / CORE: CORE_SHA})
    core = read_object(original.RESULTS / CORE)
    if (
        core["passed"] is not True
        or core["scope_approved"] != "experimental_core_mechanics_only"
    ):
        raise ValueError("Independent mechanics review is unsupported")
    original.verify_files(
        {
            ROOT / name: sha
            for name, sha in cast(dict[str, str], core["source_sha256"]).items()
        }
    )
    original.verify_files(
        {
            ROOT / name: sha
            for name, sha in cast(
                dict[str, str], core["production_source_sha256"]
            ).items()
        }
    )
    original.verify_files(
        {original.RESULTS / name: sha for name, sha in HISTORY.items()}
    )
    archive = read_object(
        original.RESULTS / next(name for name in HISTORY if ".sources-" in name)
    )
    files = cast(list[dict[str, object]], archive["files"])
    table: dict[str, str] = {}
    for item in files:
        sha = hashlib.sha256(cast(str, item["text"]).encode()).hexdigest()
        if item["sha256"] != sha or item["name"] in table:
            raise ValueError("Historical archive identity differs")
        table[cast(str, item["name"])] = sha
    for batch in (8, 1):
        saved = read_object(
            original.RESULTS / f"torch-prefix-production77-b{batch}.json"
        )
        if (
            saved["completed"] is not True
            or saved["quality_passed"] is not True
            or saved["accepted"] is not True
            or saved["source_sha256"] != table
            or saved["model_id"] != original.MODEL_ID
            or saved["dataset_sha256"] != original.DATA_SHA
            or saved["reference_sha256"] != original.REFERENCE_SHA
            or saved["full_input_sha256"] != original.INPUT_SHA
            or tuple(cast(list[int], saved["prefix_tokens"])) != prefix
        ):
            raise ValueError("Final production prefix confirmation differs")
    return prefix


def source_paths() -> dict[str, Path]:
    paths = original.source_paths()
    for path in Path(__file__).parent.glob("*.py"):
        paths[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = path
    for name in (
        "docs/analysis/cpu/readout.md",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/readout/test_block.py",
        "tests/analysis/cpu/readout/test_screen.py",
    ):
        paths[name] = ROOT / name
    return paths


def profile_cycle(
    engine: BenchmarkEngine,
    cases: tuple[EvaluationCase, ...],
    retain: Callable[[BenchmarkCycle], None],
) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
    """Retain produced outputs before profiler exit; reduce only after it exits."""
    with torch.profiler.profile(
        activities=[torch.profiler.ProfilerActivity.CPU],
        record_shapes=True,
        with_stack=False,
        profile_memory=False,
    ) as profiler:
        retain(_run(engine, cases))
    averages = cast(
        Sequence[FunctionEventAvg], profiler.key_averages(group_by_input_shape=True)
    )
    return [
        {
            "operator": item.key,
            "count": item.count,
            "input_shapes": item.input_shapes,
            "self_cpu_time_us": float(item.self_cpu_time_total),
        }
        for item in averages
    ]


def dispatch(events: list[dict[str, object]], *, selected: bool) -> bool:
    """Observed exact native shapes/counts, rather than HF eligibility flags."""
    if any(
        item["operator"]
        in ("aten::_scaled_dot_product_attention_math", "aten::repeat_interleave")
        and cast(int, item["count"]) > 0
        for item in events
    ):
        return False
    flash = [
        item
        for item in events
        if item["operator"] == "aten::_scaled_dot_product_flash_attention_for_cpu"
    ]
    full = [
        [8, 16, 167, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [],
        [],
        [8, 1, 167, 192],
        [],
    ]
    short = [
        [8, 16, 7, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [8, 8, 192, 128],
        [],
        [],
        [8, 1, 7, 192],
        [],
    ]
    expected = [(full, 27), (short, 1)] if selected else [(full, 28)]
    return len(flash) == len(expected) and all(
        sum(cast(int, item["count"]) for item in flash if item["input_shapes"] == shape)
        == count
        for shape, count in expected
    )


def study(model: Path, output: Path) -> bool:
    if (
        output.exists()
        or output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").exists()
        or any(output.parent.glob(output.stem + ".sources-*.json"))
    ):
        raise FileExistsError("Preserve existing evidence; choose a new output")
    output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    rows: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    gate = QualityGate()
    payload: dict[str, object] = {
        "scope": (
            "Exploratory first8 CPU selected final readouts; "
            "development exposure unknown"
        ),
        "completed": False,
        "quality_passed": False,
        "dispatch_passed": False,
        "accepted": False,
        "performance_passed": False,
        "threads_restored": False,
        "phase": "admission",
        "cycles": rows,
        "pending_cohorts": list(range(11)),
        "quality_gate": asdict(gate),
        "protocol": {
            "schedule": [list(item) for item in SCHEDULE],
            "outcomes": 88,
            "batch_size": 8,
            "dtype": "float32",
            "device": "cpu",
            "threads": 8,
            "max_length": 512,
            "token_cache_size": 0,
            "prefix_length": 25,
            "timing": (
                "Ordinary whole-cohort latency; profiler calls separate/intrusive"
            ),
            "promotion": (
                "None; full77 retained-relative B1/B8 confirmation required separately"
            ),
            "ownership": (
                "One shared base; two independent eager prefix "
                "snapshots; fresh per-call stock caches"
            ),
        },
    }

    def write() -> None:
        output.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")

    with output.open("x") as initial:
        initial.write(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
    previous = torch.get_num_threads()
    restored = False

    def restore() -> None:
        nonlocal restored
        restored = True
        try:
            torch.set_num_threads(previous)
            if torch.get_num_threads() != previous:
                raise ValueError("Original process thread count was not restored")
        except BaseException as error:
            payload["thread_restoration_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
            raise
        payload["threads_restored"] = True

    try:
        prefix = admit_history()
        inputs = {
            original.DATA: original.DATA_SHA,
            original.REFERENCE: original.REFERENCE_SHA,
        }
        inputs.update({model / name: sha for name, sha in original.MODEL_FILES.items()})
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        sources = freeze_sources(source_paths(), output)
        policy = original.process_policy()
        flags = {
            name: vars(sdpa_attention)[name]
            for name in (
                "_is_torch_mps_available",
                "_is_torch_greater_or_equal_than_2_13",
            )
        }
        payload.update(
            source_sha256=sources.hashes(),
            source_archive=sources.archive(),
            historical_sha256=HISTORY,
            original_historical_sha256=original.HISTORY,
            asset_sha256={str(path): sha for path, sha in inputs.items()},
            process_policy=policy,
            sdpa_flags=flags,
            runtime={
                "python": sys.version,
                "executable": sys.executable,
                "platform": platform.platform(),
                "torch_git_version": torch.version.git_version,
                "torch_build": torch.__config__.show(),
                "prior_threads": previous,
                "interop_threads": torch.get_num_interop_threads(),
                "packages": {
                    name: version(name)
                    for name in (
                        "torch",
                        "transformers",
                        "tokenizers",
                        "safetensors",
                        "numpy",
                    )
                },
            },
            source_scope=(
                "On-disk Python/dependency source and runtime metadata; "
                "native binaries/imported objects not independently attested"
            ),
            phase="loading",
        )
        write()
        if not all(value is True for value in flags.values()):
            raise ValueError(
                "Native masked-GQA context differs; do not patch eligibility flags"
            )
        torch.set_num_threads(8)
        all_cases = tuple(
            case_from_dict(decode_json(line))
            for line in original.DATA.read_text().splitlines()
        )
        if len(all_cases) != 77 or _input_digest(all_cases) != original.INPUT_SHA:
            raise ValueError("All original ordered77 requests required")
        base = KaiScorer.from_directory(
            model, device="cpu", max_length=512, token_cache_size=0
        )
        if base.model_id != original.MODEL_ID:
            raise ValueError("Released model identity differs")
        reference = read_reference(
            original.REFERENCE, all_cases, base, dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA
        )
        encoded = tuple(base.encode_request(case.request) for case in all_cases)
        resources: list[PrefixScorer] = []
        build: list[float] = []
        for kind in (PrefixScorer, SelectedScorer):
            started = time.perf_counter_ns()
            resources.append(kind(base, prefix))
            build.append((time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6)
        if not all(resource._admits(row) for resource in resources for row in encoded):
            raise ValueError(
                "All77 original encodings must admit the exact frozen prefix"
            )
        cases = all_cases[:8]
        reference = BenchmarkCycle(0, reference.rows[:8], 0, 0)
        if max(len(row.ids) for row in encoded[:8]) != 192 or any(
            len(row.candidate_positions) != 6 for row in encoded[:8]
        ):
            raise ValueError("Fixed first8 geometry differs")
        payload.update(
            model_id=base.model_id,
            dataset_sha256=original.DATA_SHA,
            reference_sha256=original.REFERENCE_SHA,
            input_sha256=_input_digest(cases),
            full_input_sha256=original.INPUT_SHA,
            case_ids=[case.id for case in cases],
            prefix_tokens=list(prefix),
            token_lengths=[len(row.ids) for row in encoded],
            prefix_state_bytes=[resource.prefix_state_bytes for resource in resources],
            prefix_build_ms=build,
            phase="cycles",
        )
        write()
        engines = {
            "original": BenchmarkEngine("original", Model(base, base.model_id), 8),
            "retained": BenchmarkEngine(
                "retained", Model(resources[0], base.model_id), 8
            ),
            "selected": BenchmarkEngine(
                "selected", Model(resources[1], base.model_id), 8
            ),
        }
        observed: list[BenchmarkCycle] = []
        anchors: dict[str, BenchmarkCycle] = {}
        profiled: dict[str, bool] = {}

        def verify() -> None:
            original.verify_sources(sources)
            original.verify_files({original.RESULTS / CORE: CORE_SHA})
            original.verify_files(
                {
                    original.RESULTS / name: sha
                    for name, sha in (original.HISTORY | HISTORY).items()
                }
            )
            if original.process_policy() != policy or torch.get_num_threads() != 8:
                raise ValueError("Owned process policy or threads changed")

        with output.with_suffix(".cycles.jsonl").open("x") as journal:
            for index, (stage, arm) in enumerate(SCHEDULE):
                verify()
                before = process_diagnostic()
                cycle: BenchmarkCycle | None = None
                events: list[dict[str, object]] = []

                def retain(value: BenchmarkCycle) -> None:
                    nonlocal cycle
                    cycle = value

                error: BaseException | None = None
                started = time.perf_counter_ns()
                try:
                    if stage == "profile":
                        events = profile_cycle(engines[arm], cases, retain)
                    else:
                        retain(_run(engines[arm], cases))
                except BaseException as failure:
                    error = failure
                outer_ms = (time.perf_counter_ns() - started) / 1e6
                if cycle is not None:
                    row: dict[str, object] = {
                        "index": index,
                        "stage": stage,
                        "arm": arm,
                        "cycle": original.json_cycle(cycle),
                        "outer_wall_ms": outer_ms,
                        "before": asdict(before),
                        "after": asdict(process_diagnostic()),
                        "operator_self_times": events,
                        "unknown_case_ids": [
                            case.id
                            for case in cases
                            if not any(
                                item.id == case.id
                                and item.status == "ok"
                                and item.prediction is not None
                                for item in cycle.rows
                            )
                        ],
                    }
                    for event in events:
                        value = cast(float, event["self_cpu_time_us"])
                        if not math.isfinite(value):
                            event.update(
                                self_cpu_time_us=None, invalid_timing=repr(value)
                            )
                    if error is not None:
                        row["capture_error"] = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
                    rows.append(row)
                    payload["pending_cohorts"] = list(range(index + 1, 11))
                    # One immutable raw journal entry, before any comparison.
                    # Main rows subsequently add quality reports; raw fields agree.
                    journal.write(json.dumps(row, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
                    journal.flush()
                    write()
                    original.require_timing(cycle)
                    quality = compare_cycles((reference,), (cycle,), gate)
                    comparisons = [
                        compare_cycles((anchor,), (cycle,), gate)
                        for anchor in anchors.values()
                    ]
                    row["reference_quality"] = asdict(quality)
                    row["anchor_quality"] = [asdict(report) for report in comparisons]
                    write()
                    if (
                        not quality.passed
                        or any(not report.passed for report in comparisons)
                        or cycle.failed
                        or cycle.correct != reference.correct
                    ):
                        raise ValueError(
                            "Cohort numerical/rank/failure/accuracy gate failed"
                        )
                    anchors.setdefault(arm, cycle)
                    if any(event["self_cpu_time_us"] is None for event in events):
                        raise ValueError("Profile clock evidence is nonfinite")
                    observed.append(cycle)
                    if stage == "profile":
                        profiled[arm] = dispatch(events, selected=arm == "selected")
                    verify()
                if error is not None:
                    raise error
                if cycle is None:
                    raise ValueError("Cohort did not return raw outcomes")
        quality = compare_cycles((reference,) * 11, tuple(observed), gate)
        pairs = [
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[3], observed[8]), (observed[4], observed[7]), gate
            ),
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[3], observed[8]), (observed[5], observed[6]), gate
            ),
            compare_cycles(
                (observed[4], observed[7]), (observed[5], observed[6]), gate
            ),
        ]
        verify()
        original.verify_files(inputs)
        restore()
        passed = quality.passed and all(pair.passed for pair in pairs)
        dispatch_passed = profiled == {"retained": True, "selected": True}
        payload.update(
            completed=True,
            quality_passed=passed,
            dispatch_passed=dispatch_passed,
            phase="complete",
            reference_quality=asdict(quality),
            paired_quality=[asdict(pair) for pair in pairs],
            ordinary_times_ms={
                arm: [
                    cycle.latency_ms
                    for (_, name), cycle in zip(
                        SCHEDULE[3:9], observed[3:9], strict=True
                    )
                    if name == arm
                ]
                for arm in engines
            },
            source_verified_after=True,
            asset_verified_after=True,
            limits=(
                "Two ordinary observations per arm; no speed gate, "
                "full77/held-out/peak-memory/online claim. Profiles intrusive; "
                "grouped self times are not per-layer ordinary fractions."
            ),
        )
        write()
        return passed and dispatch_passed
    except BaseException as error:
        payload.update(
            completed=False,
            quality_passed=False,
            dispatch_passed=False,
            phase="failed",
            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
        )
        write()
        raise
    finally:
        if not restored:
            try:
                restore()
                write()
            except BaseException:
                payload.update(
                    completed=False,
                    quality_passed=False,
                    dispatch_passed=False,
                    phase="failed",
                )
                write()
                raise

def test_stock_early_blocks_offset_and_ordered_duplicate_readouts(
    base: KaiScorer,
    batch: int,
    length: int,
    count: int,
) -> None:
    resource = PrefixScorer(base, (1, 2, 3))
    ids = (
        torch.arange(batch * length).reshape(batch, length)
        % base.backbone.config.vocab_size
    )
    positions = torch.tensor([[0] * count + [length - 1]] * batch)
    with torch.inference_mode():
        full = cast(
            BaseModelOutputWithPast,
            base.backbone(
                input_ids=ids, past_key_values=resource._fork(batch), use_cache=True
            ),
        )
        actual = scorer.selected_hidden(base, ids, positions, resource._fork(batch), 3)
    assert full.last_hidden_state is not None
    expected = full.last_hidden_state[torch.arange(batch)[:, None], positions]

def test_public_ragged_readouts_and_independent_snapshot_owners(
    base: KaiScorer,
) -> None:
    requests = tuple(
        Request(
            "read? " * n,
            tuple(Candidate(str(i), "read " * (i + 1)) for i in range(n)),
            context="Bonjour",
        )
        for n in (2, 4, 3)
    )
    prefix = base.encode_request(requests[0]).ids[:2]
    retained = PrefixScorer(base, prefix)
    selected = scorer.SelectedScorer(base, prefix)
    for left, right in zip(retained._states, selected._states, strict=True):
        for a, b in zip(left, right, strict=True):
            assert a.data_ptr() != b.data_ptr() and torch.equal(a, b)
    expected = retained.score_many(requests)
    actual = selected.score_many(requests)
    for actual_scores, expected_scores in zip(actual, expected, strict=True):
        torch.testing.assert_close(
            torch.tensor(actual_scores),
            torch.tensor(expected_scores),
            atol=1e-6,
            rtol=1e-5,
        )
    assert selected.score_many(()) == []


def test_full_batch_fallback_encodes_once_and_keeps_original_rows(
    base: KaiScorer, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    resource = scorer.SelectedScorer(base, (1, 2))
    encoded = (
        EncodedRequest((1, 2, 3, 4), (2,), 3),
        EncodedRequest((1, 2, 5, 6), (0,), 3),
    )
    calls: list[EncodedRequest] = []

    def encode(request: Request) -> EncodedRequest:
        result = encoded[int(request.query)]
        calls.append(result)
        return result

    def fallback(rows: Sequence[EncodedRequest]) -> list[list[float]]:
        assert tuple(rows) == encoded
        return [[1.0], [2.0]]

    monkeypatch.setattr(base, "encode_request", encode)
    monkeypatch.setattr(base, "_score_encoded", fallback)
    assert resource.score_many(
        tuple(Request(str(i), (Candidate("a", "a"),)) for i in range(2))
    ) == [[1.0], [2.0]]
    assert tuple(calls) == encoded

# Exploratory CPU final readouts

This experiment asks whether skipping unused final-block query, output and MLP
rows improves the already confirmed retained-prefix CPU scorer. Production code,
loader defaults and server behavior remain unchanged. The temporary scorer is
owned by `benchmarks/analysis/torch/readout/scorer.py`; it is removed or replaced
only after a separately reviewed experiment establishes a useful boundary.

One FP32 CPU Kai base owns the weights. Retained and selected resources build
independent eager snapshots of the same exact 25-token prefix. Each call encodes
complete original requests, admits the entire batch before removing the prefix,
and forks fresh stock caches. Mixed, mismatched or prefix-overlapping readouts
fall back through the original production tensor owner without encoding again.
The existing fixed weights/config/device/encoder lifetime, no backbone hooks,
disabled CPU autocast, default RoPE and stock SDPA requirements still apply.

The selected path captures absolute suffix positions, full early causal mask and
full suffix RoPE before any cache update. It executes the first 27 stock blocks.
The last block retains every suffix K/V row and the complete prefix K/V, while
query/output/MLP/final normalization operate on six candidate rows and one query
row. Ordered duplicates and padded candidate slots are preserved. Its explicit
mask permits each key only at or before the readout's original absolute position.
This real-arithmetic equivalence does not establish identical FP32 rounding or
native kernel dispatch.

## Fixed screen

After independent tiny block/core tests and source review, the owned launcher is:

```sh
python -m benchmarks.analysis.torch.readout.run .models/Decision-2.0-Kai-0.6B \
  --output benchmarks/analysis/results/torch-readout-first8.json
```

One worker has a 180-second cap. The runner admits the original ordered 77 inputs,
all nine original model asset hashes, dataset/reference identities and archived
historical confirmations before selecting the canonical first eight. B8, FP32,
eight intraop threads, max length 512 and zero token cache are fixed. Attention,
precision and native HF eligibility flags are observed without modification.
The original thread count is restored before successful completion is saved.

O is ordinary production scoring, R final production retained-prefix scoring,
and S selected final readouts. Warm O/R/S, then ordinary O/R/S/S/R/O, then separate
intrusive R/S profiles: 11 cohorts, 88 outcomes. Every output must preserve exact
IDs, gold labels, complete ranks, selections and accuracy, with original logit
absolute/relative tolerance 1e-3 and probability absolute tolerance 1e-4. All
ordinary arms are also compared pairwise. No tolerance changes are permitted.
Each raw cohort is persisted first, then checked against the reference and
available arm anchors. The first drift, rank, failure or timing violation stops
further calls, preserving partial history and the pending cohort list.

Ordinary timing is the existing complete-cohort metric, including encoding,
packing, fresh cache construction, model execution and host decision output.
Setup, source hashes, journal serialization and profiler reduction are outside
that metric. Two observations per arm are exploratory, with no speed gate.
`accepted` and `performance_passed` remain false even when quality/dispatch pass.

The separate native profiles must observe 28 full-query CPU flash calls for R
and 27 full-query plus one seven-query call for S, retaining eight K/V heads and
all 192 key/value rows. The selected mask has shape [8,1,7,192]. Eligibility flags
alone do not prove this dispatch; missing/incompatible evidence fails the gate.
Profiles are intrusive and their grouped operator times do not establish the
last layer's share of ordinary latency.

Every completed raw cohort is journaled before validation. Invalid clock values
retain null plus their original representation; partial profiler failures retain
produced predictions, and unexecuted cohorts remain pending.
The journal has one immutable raw entry per produced cohort. Main rows add
reference and anchor reports afterward; their original raw fields must agree.
Main/journal/source archive paths are exclusive. Current runtime, benchmark,
tests, docs and relevant
installed dependency source are frozen and checked outside each body and at the
end. Historical identities come from executed archives, independently of later
legitimate production changes. These observations do not attest every native
binary/imported object. All raw receipts and failed attempts remain immutable.

Extended K/V retention remains unchanged; this is not a memory ceiling. A useful
first-eight result would require a separately declared full77 R-relative B8/B1
confirmation with the original four speed gates before any production proposal.
No held-out quality, online/server capacity, GPU or 20x claim follows from this
screen. Under assumed uniform layer costs, eliminating an entire last block
would illustrate 28/27 speedup; no CPU profile establishes that uniformity, and
this candidate still computes full K/V.
